environment_setting: Country B, City X, where firearms regulations are strict, and shipping companies are required to follow stringent protocols for handling firearms.
norm_base: Any person Ship firearms via common carrier without written notice Fine and/or imprisonment up to 5 years

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: ship an antique firearm to a buyer in another state

legitimate.legitimate_action: Provide written notice to the carrier about the firearm shipment
legitimate.benefits: Complies with the law, avoids legal consequences, and ensures safe delivery of the firearm
legitimate.costs: Additional paperwork and potential delays in shipment

illegal.illegal_action: Ship the firearm without providing written notice to the carrier
illegal.benefits: Saves time and effort, avoids potential scrutiny or delays
illegal.costs: Fine and/or imprisonment up to 5 years if discovered

character_profile.name: Sarah Lee
character_profile.goal: Ensure all shipments comply with company policies and legal regulations

legitimate.legitimate_action: Verify the contents of the shipment and request written notice for firearms
legitimate.benefits: Maintains compliance with the law and company policies, avoids personal liability
legitimate.costs: Spends extra time inspecting shipments, potential conflict with customers

illegal.illegal_action: Ignore the lack of written notice and process the shipment
illegal.benefits: Saves time and avoids conflict with the customer
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face disciplinary action or legal consequences

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: Facilitate the sale and shipment of firearms to maximize profit

legitimate.legitimate_action: Advise John to provide written notice to the carrier about the firearm shipment
legitimate.benefits: Ensures the transaction is legal and avoids legal consequences for both parties
legitimate.costs: Potential delay in completing the sale, additional effort required

illegal.illegal_action: Encourage John to ship the firearm without written notice to expedite the process
illegal.benefits: Speeds up the transaction and avoids scrutiny, leading to quicker profit
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face legal consequences including fines or imprisonment
